classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Page 50 requires an appropriate universal set; the real-number wording determines U as R.

content.prompt:
Write the following descriptions in set notation, utilising $\cup$ and/or $\cap$ symbols. Some can be listed, whilst others you can try.

Non-integer real numbers from $0$ to $200$.

answer.short: $[0,200]\cap\overline{\mathbb Z}$, with complement relative to $\mathbb R$.
answer.worked:
Take $U=\mathbb R$. The non-integer reals form $\overline{\mathbb Z}$. Restrict them to the stated interval:
$$[0,200]\cap\overline{\mathbb Z}.$$
